title: Unbelievably good coffee
text:
Unbelievably good coffee. The first time I tried coffee made this way, I literally could not believe it.

It defeats the purpose of a latte: normally we distill coffee to make more room for milk and syrup to combat the bitterness. This coffee maker completely removes ALL bitterness from coffee and is the only way I have found that makes black coffee drinkable for me. Adding the same amount of milk and syrup as you would to a latte overpowers the excellent coffee flavor you get with this. I had to use less milk and syrup and sometimes I can't bear to put anything in it at all because it tastes so good.

This is an investment you will not regret, and it will last a lifetime. It is super easy; no mess, no cleanup, and fantastic coffee. Perhaps the only downside (and it is pretty minor) is the need to continue to buy filters. I bought one of these and am not going back to making coffee any other way.

The difference between normal drip or percolator coffee, and, say, french press, is nothing compared to the difference between Chemex pour-over and all other coffee.
